description: This file defines the 'GameScreen' widget for a Flutter-based word-guessing game. It assembles UI components such as the game board, keyboard, feedback banners, and stats modal, managing interactions and state via the GameController.

classes.name: GameScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget that builds the main game UI for the word-guessing game, including app bar, game board, feedback banner, keyboard, and stats modal.

methods.name: _openStats
methods.description: Opens a modal bottom sheet displaying game statistics with an option to start a new game.

methods.name: _confirmRestart
methods.description: Shows a confirmation dialog to restart the game; if confirmed, starts a new game.
